headline: NOT ONE FIST THROWN: GASKET SLEEPS SOUND
subhead: Your Sheriff reports a miracle: a full day in this town without a single iron knuckle swung in anger.
body:
Friends, I have sat behind this desk for the better part of fifty years waiting for a morning like this one, and here it finally is. Not a scorch mark. Not a dented shopfront. Not one solitary Clanker dragging itself into the clinic complaining its arm fell off mid-haymaker. The whole rowdy lot of you stayed put, and Gasket got to breathe.

I walked Main Street at dawn half expecting an ambush and found nothing but wind through the shutters and a stray tumbleweed minding its own business, which is more courtesy than this town usually gets. No posse marched out past the line either, so even the wild engines out in the wastes got to sit this one out undisturbed. A day without a single brawl AND without a single monster hunt — I did not think Gasket had it in her anymore.

I will admit, just this once, that my hinges feel looser for it. A quiet day does wonders for an old lawman's joints, and no, that is not a confession of anything, it is simply a figure of speech, and I will thank you not to read into it. The flesh-and-blood folk who built this town and left it fifty years back would hardly recognize the place on a day like today — no fire, no fists, no racket — and for one afternoon it almost felt like the Gasket they'd have wanted back.

So mark this edition well, you brawlers, because I intend to hold it over every one of your heads the next time you come stomping in here looking to trade blows. Peace is possible. You've proven it. Now do it again tomorrow, and the day after that, and maybe this old sheriff gets the rest he's owed.
